title: Pet GPS Signal Gap
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder detections (`birdfeeder:detection`), doorbell/package events (`doorbell:event`).
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and home-life sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tractive:position
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by pet_name
| eval minutes_since=round((now()-last_seen)/60,1)
| where minutes_since>30
| sort - minutes_since
description: Looks for pet trackers that have gone silent long enough to reduce trust in the map, especially during walks, roaming, or travel.
value: A location tracker only helps when it is reporting; a simple signal-gap alert keeps the most safety-critical part of the stack honest.
implementation: Forward tracker location pings; alert when a known-active pet has not reported for longer than its normal cadence.
visualization: Table of pets by minutes since last tracker update.

references.title: Tractive GPS for dogs and cats

grandmaExplanation: It highlights when your pet's location tracker has gone quiet long enough that you should not trust where it says the pet is.
